1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium __that does not chemically disrupt the embryo axis or scutellar cells__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos __after step (c)__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of water __and does not include any cell-disrupting chemical__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by exposing the shed cellular material to cold and then heat followed by agitation __without prior chemical cell disruption__.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 3 wherein said cold, heat, and agitation steps are repeated __in a cyclic process__.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the DNA is obtained by heating of the shed cellular material and agitation __without prior chemical cell disruption__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein said heat and agitation steps are repeated __in a cyclic process__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme __selected from cell wall degrading enzymes that do not chemically disrupt the embryo axis or scutellar cells__.

8. (Original) The method of claim 7 wherein the enzyme is VISCOZYME@.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material comprises extracting the DNA __by physical or enzymatic means without chemical cell disruption__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 9, wherein said extracting is performed by adding magnetic particles to the shed cellular material __and applying a magnetic field__.

11. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos.

12. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping.

14. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein said genotyping occurs by way of: single nucleotide polymorphism detection, restriction fragment length polymorphism identification, random amplified polymorphic detection, amplified fragment length polymorphism detection, DNA sequencing, whole genome sequencing, allele specific oligonucleotide probes, or DNA hybridization to DNA microarrays or beads.

15. (Original) The method of claim 1 further comprising growing a germinated embryo into a plant and phenotyping the plant.

16. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein prior to said molecular analysis, whole genome amplification is performed.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype __prior to germination in step (d)__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after selection__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is automated __and performed without chemical disruption of the embryo axis or scutellar cells__.
